stable.notes: COS Activity opens Messages, Speakers, Memories, and Threads in one resizable window with tabs, Home, Back, and scoped breadcrumbs. The new Voice Directory shows enrolled voices, observed-match evidence, attributed and review segments, meeting history, and meeting-local unidentified voices without merging them into false global identities. Late responses cannot overwrite newer selections, closing Activity stops playback, and Finder-launched server updates now resolve npm reliably. Requires glasses-server 6.27.1 for full Voice Directory history.
